collection.description: A father considers how to feed his newborn.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (Name1), a father, considers how to feed his newborn. Villagers offer competing advice, but his body, comfort, available milk, and the baby's needs all matter.

choices.label: Ask Another Caregiver to Share Feeds
Try Chestfeeding If He Wishes and Can
Set a Firm Boundary with Advisers

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: They work out a practical feeding plan without judgment.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: The first approach proves difficult, and they revise the plan.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: The family finds a routine that gives him time to recover.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: Their schedules clash, and they negotiate a better arrangement.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: He finds a position that works for him and the baby.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: It is uncomfortable or ineffective, so he seeks another method.

d1.name: Outcome D1
d1.text: The unsolicited comments stop, at least for the afternoon.

d2.name: Outcome D2
d2.text: One villager takes offense; he keeps the boundary anyway.
